national.title: How to Apply for an Ayushman Bharat Card in India (2026)
national.summary: Master procedure for obtaining an Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY health card from the National Health Authority across India. Verified guide covering Aadhaar e-KYC authentication, family ration card seeding, five lakh rupee cashless treatment, and instant card download.

steps.title: Verify Family Eligibility on Beneficiary Portal
steps.description: Visit the official National Health Authority beneficiary portal. Enter your mobile number, select your state, and search using Aadhaar or ration card.
steps.calloutText: Search by ration card number or family ID if your direct Aadhaar search does not show results immediately.

steps.title: Select Beneficiary Member and e-KYC Mode
steps.description: Locate your family member profile in the search results. Select the pending e-KYC option and choose Aadhaar OTP, iris, or facial scan.

steps.title: Authenticate via Aadhaar OTP or Biometrics
steps.description: Enter your 12-digit Aadhaar number to trigger an authentication OTP. Submit the six-digit code sent to your UIDAI registered mobile number.
steps.calloutText: Ensure your phone receives text messages from UIDAI to complete Aadhaar OTP verification successfully.

steps.title: Capture Live Selfie for Facial Match
steps.description: Use your mobile camera or computer webcam to capture a live photograph. The system matches your photo against UIDAI biometric records.
steps.calloutText: Face the camera directly in bright lighting without hats, masks, or dark spectacles for immediate matching.

steps.title: Verify Contact and Household Address Details
steps.description: Review auto-filled demographic details retrieved from Aadhaar. Confirm your pin code, rural or urban classification, and sub-district details.

steps.title: Submit Application for State Health Agency Approval
steps.description: Submit your completed e-KYC request. High-confidence biometric matches receive instant automated approval while minor discrepancies go for officer scrutiny.

steps.title: Download Official Ayushman e-Card
steps.description: Upon approval, the card status turns green. Click the download button to save your official PDF Ayushman Bharat card.
steps.calloutText: You can save the verified digital card directly to your DigiLocker app for cashless hospital admissions.

steps.title: Avail Cashless Hospital Treatment
steps.description: Present the digital or printed card at any empanelled public or private hospital nationwide to receive cashless inpatient healthcare.
steps.where: Empanelled Network Hospital / Ayushman Mitra Desk

documentRequirements.name: Applicant Aadhaar Card
documentRequirements.description: Original 12-digit Aadhaar card linked with active mobile phone number for OTP authentication.
documentRequirements.copiesHint: Original Aadhaar card or digital copy on DigiLocker.

documentRequirements.name: Eligible Family Ration Card or Household ID
documentRequirements.description: State Food and Civil Supplies ration card showing applicant name and family member list.
documentRequirements.copiesHint: 1 self-attested photocopy or digital ration card number.

documentRequirements.name: Active Mobile Number for OTP Verification
documentRequirements.description: Working mobile handset capable of receiving real-time SMS one-time passwords.
documentRequirements.copiesHint: Active SIM card with mobile connectivity.

documentRequirements.name: Prime Minister Entitlement Letter
documentRequirements.description: Official letter addressed to household head containing unique Ayushman family HHID.
documentRequirements.copiesHint: Original PM letter containing family QR code barcode.

documentRequirements.name: Age Proof for 70+ Universal Cover
documentRequirements.description: Aadhaar card or certified birth record establishing applicant age is 70 years or older.
documentRequirements.copiesHint: 1 photocopy of Aadhaar confirming 70+ age milestone.

documentRequirements.name: Unique Disability Identity Card (UDID)
documentRequirements.description: Official UDID certificate for expedited priority verification at hospital Ayushman Mitra helpdesks.

fees.label: Online e-KYC and Card Download Fee
fees.description: The central government provides online application, verification, and digital card downloads completely free.

fees.label: Physical PVC Ayushman Card at Hospital
fees.description: Government empaneled hospitals issue the initial physical PVC card free of cost to eligible patients.

rejectionReasons.title: Family Missing from SECC Database
rejectionReasons.description: Household is not mapped in SECC 2011 records or active state priority ration lists.
rejectionReasons.solution: Link family members to an active NFSA ration card or apply under expanded senior citizen schemes.

rejectionReasons.title: Demographic Data Mismatch with Aadhaar
rejectionReasons.description: Name spelling or date of birth on ration card differs significantly from Aadhaar records.
rejectionReasons.solution: Update the demographic details on your Aadhaar card or food civil supplies database to match.

rejectionReasons.title: Failed Live Selfie Facial Recognition
rejectionReasons.description: Poor lighting or facial accessories cause low biometric match score against UIDAI photo records.
rejectionReasons.solution: Retake the live selfie photograph in bright daylight facing camera squarely without eyeglasses.

rejectionReasons.title: Unlinked Mobile Number for OTP
rejectionReasons.description: Aadhaar card lacks an active linked phone number to receive the mandatory e-KYC code.
rejectionReasons.solution: Visit a local Aadhaar Seva Kendra to link your active phone or authenticate using biometric fingerprint scanners.

rejectionReasons.title: Inactive or Split Ration Card
rejectionReasons.description: Ration card suspended due to non-lifting of grains or non-completion of mandatory family e-KYC.
rejectionReasons.solution: Visit your local taluka food office or Fair Price Shop to restore active ration card status.

rejectionReasons.title: Duplicate e-KYC Submission
rejectionReasons.description: Attempting to create a second card when an active Ayushman card is already issued.
rejectionReasons.solution: Login to the beneficiary portal to re-download your existing active card without reapplying.

faqItems.question: What is the financial coverage provided by Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY?
faqItems.answer: PM-JAY provides up to five lakh rupees per eligible family per year for secondary and tertiary hospital treatments.

faqItems.question: Who is eligible to get an Ayushman Bharat Card?
faqItems.answer: Families listed in SECC 2011 deprivation categories, eligible NFSA ration card holders, and citizens aged 70 and above.

faqItems.question: Are citizens aged 70 and above eligible regardless of family income?
faqItems.answer: Yes. The central government approved universal health coverage for all senior citizens aged 70 and older without income caps.

faqItems.question: Is there any fee to apply for or download an Ayushman Card?
faqItems.answer: No. Online e-KYC, digital card downloads, and physical cards at public hospitals are 100% free of charge.

faqItems.question: Can I use the Ayushman Card in private hospitals?
faqItems.answer: Yes. The card is accepted across thousands of empaneled private and public hospitals nationwide for cashless inpatient care.

faqItems.question: What is e-KYC and why is it mandatory for Ayushman Bharat?
faqItems.answer: e-KYC electronically matches your Aadhaar biometrics to prevent identity theft and ensure benefits reach genuine beneficiaries.

faqItems.question: How long is an Ayushman Bharat Card valid?
faqItems.answer: The card has lifetime validity as long as the family or individual remains eligible under program guidelines.

faqItems.question: What should I do if my family name is missing from the portal?
faqItems.answer: Ensure your state ration card has all member names added, or check if eligible under age 70+ expansion schemes.

beforeYouGo.title: Before You Apply for Ayushman Card

items.title: Check Household Ration Card Inclusion
items.description: Confirm all family member names are registered on your active state ration card.

items.title: Ensure Mobile Number Linked to Aadhaar
items.description: Have access to the mobile handset linked to Aadhaar for receiving OTP codes.

items.title: Sit in Well-Lit Space for Live Photo
items.description: Ensure ample daylight or room lighting for capturing facial biometric photographs.

items.title: Keep Original Aadhaar Cards Ready
items.description: Have original Aadhaar cards of each family member ready during enrollment.

items.title: Locate Empanelled Hospitals Nearby
items.description: Check the official list of nearby empanelled hospitals for cashless treatments.
